questions.text: What are the factors that led to the success of democracy?
questions.text_as_printed: What are the factors that led to the success of democracy? (E)

answer.value:
Factors essential for the success of democracy:
1. People should have an urge to protect democracy.
2. People must always be vigilant.
3. Tolerance is one of the basic qualities needed for the success of democracy. They must work with the spirit of give and take.
4. Success of democracy depends upon good leadership. The leaders must have the ability to understand the problems of the common man. They must possess the qualities of service, patriotism and spirit of sacrifice.
5. An efficient opposition party keeps the government alert. It checks the ruling party from becoming dictatorial.
6. A well informed and educated electorate contributes to the success of democracy.
7. Success of democracy depends upon the role of the people. People must compulsorily vote during the election. People must be free from corrupt practices. The people must elect efficient and non-corrupt representatives who can solve their problems.
8. Free, fearless and unbiased press contributes to the success of democracy.
9. Well organized, efficient and responsible local bodies strengthen democracy.

questions.answer_as_printed:
Indirect Democracy:
People elect their representatives through periodic elections.
Elected members formulate laws and manage administration.
India follows an indirect democratic system.

1. People should have an urge to protect democracy.
2. People must always be vigilant.
3. Tolerance is one of the basic qualities needed for the success of democracy. They must work with the spirit of give and take.

4. Success of democracy depends upon good leadership. The leaders must have the ability to understand the problems of the common man. They must possess the qualities of service, patriotism and spirit of sacrifice.
5. An efficient opposition party keeps the government alert. It checks the ruling party from becoming dictatorial.
6. A well informed and educated electorate contributes to the success of democracy.

7. Success of democracy depends upon the role of the people. People must compulsorily vote during the election. People must be free from corrupt practices. The people must elect efficient and non-corrupt representatives who can solve their problems.
8. Free, fearless and unbiased press contributes to the success of democracy.
9. Well organized, efficient and responsible local bodies strengthen democracy.

questions.text_as_printed: Explain the salient features of the democratic system (A)

answer.value:
Features of Democracy are:
It is the government of people.
People elect their representatives.
Representatives create laws on behalf of their people.
It is based on universal adult franchise.
All citizens are equal before the law.
Political parties exist in this system.
It focuses on the all-round development of citizens.
Democracy opposes personality cults.

questions.text: What are the disadvantages of democracy? (Explain)
questions.text_as_printed: What are the disadvantages of democracy? (Explain) (A)

answer.value:
Disadvantages of Democracy
Democracy becomes weak when public representatives lack proper educational qualifications, administrative skills, good leadership qualities, and social, economic, and political awareness, and act out of self-interest.
Competition among political parties for power leads to bias and corruption.
Party interests become more important than national interests.
Defection from one party to another makes governments unstable.
In a democratic system, the use of caste, religion, money, and muscle power during elections weakens the government.
Law-making in a democracy is a lengthy process.
Conducting elections is expensive and the process takes a long time.
Illiterate and poor people may be exploited by those in power.
Anti-social elements may influence the government using money and muscle power.
